text:
Olivia: Hi @people-ops — I wanted to let you know I'm handing in my resignation today. My proposed last day is 2024-05-12. Can we start the offboarding checklist? Need clarifications on benefits end date, COBRA steps, laptop return, and access removal.Thanks.
Marcus: Thanks for the heads up, Olivia — appreciate the early notice. We'll sort coverage. Can you confirm your last active day and whether you'll be onsite for any handover? Also please add a short doc with outstanding tasks.
Olivia: Last active day = 2024-05-12 (remote). I can do 2 handoff sessions the week before. I left my work laptop at the SF office — asset tag: RDN-02345. I'll ship it back if needed.
Ada (People Ops): Hi @Olivia — sorry to hear you're leaving. We'll run through the offboarding steps. Quick bullets: 1) Benefits termination is end-of-day on your last day (2024-05-12). 2) COBRA packet is mailed/emailed within 14 business days after coverage ends; you have 60 days to elect COBRA from the date you receive the notice or from the coverage end date depending on carrier. 3) Final paycheck + PTO payout timeline: processed on next payroll cycle; you'll get details by email. 4) Exit interview: we can schedule a 30-min slot — do mornings or afternoons work?
Olivia: Morning slots better. Also: how does billing work for COBRA? Is it retroactive to 5/13 or the day after end of coverage?
Ada (People Ops): COBRA coverage is retroactive to the day after your employer coverage ends (so 2024-05-13). When you elect, monthly premium payments are due per the carrier's schedule; first payment typically covers the retroactive period, so there may be an initial prorated invoice. We'll attach carrier contact info in the packet.
IT-bot: Asset deprovision checklist: please confirm asset tag + serial and request UPS label if shipping. When confirmed, IT will schedule device wipe on the day after last active day unless manager requests earlier. Command snippet for asset record:
```
asset_tag: RDN-02345
serial: SN-7F4K9
location: SF-2C
owner: Olivia
```
Marcus: Can you put a condensed runbook for your 2 critical services? 15-20 min walkthrough should be fine. Also tagging @Security — make sure no active long-lived keys remain in repos.
Security: @Marcus @Olivia we'll audit access the morning after last active day. Please self-check any personal tokens in dotfiles and rotate if needed. We'll revoke org-level credentials and SSO tokens on 2024-05-13 09:00 PT.
Olivia: I'll scrub personal tokens and push a short README for the services today. Also confirm: do I need to hand in the encrypted YubiKey? Where to drop off?
Ada (People Ops): Yes if you have company hardware (YubiKey, laptop charger, monitor) please use the SF asset return locker or request a prepaid label. I'll DM you the locker code and the return instructions. For credentials: if you have a company-managed YubiKey, mark it for return and we'll mark the device in the asset system.
Marcus: Thanks everyone. Olivia — would you be willing to do a 30-min exit interview the week of 5/13? People Ops will send Calendly.
Olivia: Yes, 30-min works. Appreciate everyone's help.
Ada (People Ops): Scheduled — exit interview booked for 2024-05-14 10:00 PT, Calendly invite sent. COBRA packet will go out <14 business days after 5/12. Final payroll team notified. I'll follow up with shipping label and locker code in DM. If anything urgent about customer data access, ping me or @Security. :handshake:
Olivia: Awesome — thanks all.
Marcus: We'll set up the handoff sessions and add notes to the team channel. :thumbsup:
